title: A variation of the inverse Fueter theorem and the generalized polyanalytic Cauchy-Kovalevskaya extension of order 2
summary: In this paper, we first establish a generalized Cauchy--Kovalevskaya (GCK) extension for axially polyanalytic functions of order $2$. We prove that the extension can be written as a power series involving differential operators acting on two initial functions. We also study the decomposition of the GCK extension in terms of integrals over the sphere 2-sphere $\mathbb{S}$ involving plane-wave type functions.
